How a book gets made

Four stages, one shelf-ready book

Skip a stage and it shows —
every book gets all four.

01 / Intake

Beta Reading

A full read from a real reader's seat — pacing, plot holes, characters that don't land, and where attention drifts. Notes you can act on, not just praise.

02 / Craft

Developmental & Line Editing

Structural passes for story and argument, then sentence-level editing for voice, rhythm, and clarity — without flattening what makes it yours.

03 / Object

Cover Design

Genre-aware covers built to work as a thumbnail first and a print jacket second, with typography and imagery that signal the right promise to the right reader.

04 / Launch

Book Marketing

Positioning, blurb, categories, and a launch sequence — the unglamorous work that decides whether the book everyone worked on actually gets found.

Hi, I'm Kehinde Reader, a beta reader, book editor, and book cover designer dedicated to helping authors create books readers can't put down.

From detailed beta reading and professional editing to eye-catching cover design, I work closely with authors to refine their stories, strengthen their writing, and present their books with confidence.

I believe every great book starts with a compelling story and ends with a memorable reading experience. My approach is collaborative, constructive, and focused on helping authors bring out the best version of their work.
